desc:
🐎 Drive Your Animals!

⚡ Hitch your animals to your carriage and train to gain Power!
🏁 Drive across 9 biomes and roll everything in your path into a huge lucky ball!
🥚 Dig up an egg, escape its giant angry mother and hatch it in your pen!
💰 Your animals earn Cash every second, so upgrade your carriage, pen and trails!
👑 Rebirth for permanent boosts, reach the Summit and become the strongest driver!

👍 Like, favourite, and follow if you enjoyed the game!
